title: Ripple Basin
description: If you did not play any Attacks during your turn, gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: The relic activates at the start of your turn and disarms if you play any Attack card. At the end of your turn, if no Attacks were played, you gain 4 Block and the relic flashes to indicate it triggered.
